newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Goldsun to issue preference shares.
newsitem.headline: Goldsun to issue preference shares.

text.p: Hungarian frozen food company Goldsun Rt will raise its 1.323 billion forint share capital by 673.2 million by a private issue of new preference shares.

Goldsun will issue two series of preference shares, Katalin Nagy, legal representative of Goldsun's two major foreign shareholders told Reuters, following shareholders' approval at an extraordinary general meeting on Friday.

The new shares consist of dividend preference shares entitling the holders to a dividend and of liquidation shares, the holders of which enjoy an absolute preference ahead other shareholders in case of liquidation of the company. @

The new shares will be subscribed by the company's two major shareholders, Israel's Sunfrost Ltd and the U.S's Shamrock Capital Investors and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, she said.

Part of the share issue will involve the conversion into equity of a $600,000 loan from Sunfrost and Shamrock to Goldsun in the first half of this year, while some of the remaining proceeds will be used to pay off liabilities, including amounts owed to suppliers.
Goldsun had first-half losses of 365 million forints on net sales of 743 million forints in 1996. @
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Goldsun shares ended at 220 forints, up 15.
